outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic and micrograph illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing; it is not a plot showing averages, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel b is a schematic and micrograph illustrating image spacing; no averaged data plot is present.
Panel c is a schematic and micrograph showing an inset/zoom; no averaged data plot is present.
Panel d shows grayscale micrographs at different brightness/contrast settings; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e is a schematic plus micrographs illustrating channel annotation visibility; no averaged data plot is present.
Panel f is a schematic and micrographs illustrating grayscale channel separation; no averaged data plot is present.
Panel g shows micrographs with color/grayscale calibration scale legends; these are intensity legends, not plots of averaged data requiring individual points.
